text: Empress Market Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Empress Market Type: Monument - Building Province: Sindh District: Karachi Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1857 - 1947 CE Description: The building was constructed during British Raj between 1884 to 1889 and named after Queen Victoria, Empress of India. It has four galleries, each 14 m wide accommodation to 280 shops and stalls. Latitude: 24.862422222 Longitude: 67.029341667 Ownership: Private Legal Status: Not Protected Title of Publication: Inventory of Cultural Property in the Province of Sindh, Pakistan, 2015 Published In: Government of Sindh, Vol 2 Year of Publication: 2015 Bibliography/Reference: Jansen, Michael, Yasmeen Lari Social Media Links Contact Info (+92) 51-9252516 info@doam.gov.pk Sir Syed Memorial Building, 19th Atta-Turk Avenue, Sector G-5/1, Islamabad Quick Links - National Heritage & Culture Division, Government of Pakistan - Directorate of Archaeology & Museums, KPK - Directorate of Archaeology Tourism Department, Punjab - Directorate of Archaeology & Museums, Balochistan - Culture, Tourism, Antiquities and Archive Department, Sindh - Tourism, Sports, Culture, Archaeology & Museums Department Gilgit-Baltistan - National Museum of Pakistan, Karachi - Islamabad Museum, Islamabad - UNESCO, Islamabad office, Islamabad - UNESCO World Heritage Centre Department of Archaeology and Museums © 2026.
